learningGoals: Understand the sequence of daily events and routines. 🌅
Learn the names and order of the days of the week. 📆
Recognize the different months of the year and basic seasons. ☀️
Begin to understand how to read time on a clock (hours). ⏱️
teachingTips: Talk about your daily routine, emphasizing words like 'first', 'next', 'morning', and 'night'. 🗣️
Keep a physical calendar at home and let them cross out the days as they pass. ❌
Point to the clock during important times like mealtime or bedtime and say the hour aloud. 🕒
Sing a fun 'Days of the Week' song together to help them memorize the order. 🎶

funActivities.title: My Daily Routine 🎨
funActivities.description: Have them draw three pictures: what they do in the morning, afternoon, and night.

funActivities.title: Calendar Fun 🎈
funActivities.description: Give them a calendar and colorful stickers to mark family birthdays and holidays.

funActivities.title: Paper Plate Clock 🍽️
funActivities.description: Make a simple clock using a paper plate, a pin, and cardboard hands to practice telling time.
